crossRefs.note: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all…

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Son of Rechab, who promoted Rechabite lifestyle

translations.web: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
translations.bsb: But we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done exactly as our forefather Jonadab commanded us.
translations.kjv: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded
translations.asv: but we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
